label: copy-phase input q (fed-back q) from a non-early position
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase when the fed-back input token is q (all activation mass is on in_tok=q, phase 2). Gating by position: always fires when the q being re-input is original token 3 or later (recall_idx >= 4, 100% precision). For q at original position 1-2 (recall_idx 2-3) it fires only when the sequence is near its end (to_go <= 2), and weakly. Never fires when q is original token 0 (recall_idx 1), never on q in the original phase (149 tiny activations) or at the delimiter, and essentially never on any other token. Magnitude: the weakest activations (bottom quartile) are q at recall_idx 2-3; the strongest (around 0.9-1.0 of max) are q at recall_idx 4-5 close to the end of the sequence. Not modulated by the output token, first token, or neighbouring tokens.

issues: The predicate's clause '(recall_idx >= 2) & (to_go <= 2)' is wrong for recall_idx==2. Scoring cells on dev: recall_idx=2 gives to_go=0 precision 1.0, to_go=1 precision 0.918, to_go=2 precision 0.0007. So q fed back at recall_idx 2 with to_go 2 (L=5, step 7, e.g. 'k q n z e <DEL> k *q* n z') almost never fires. That one cell causes about 2.7k of the 3510 test false positives.

The explanation says original tokens 1 or 2 fire when to_go <= 2. That is wrong. Original token 1 (recall_idx 2) fires only at to_go <= 1. Original token 2 (recall_idx 3) fires reliably at to_go <= 2 (precision 1.0, 1.0, 0.79). At to_go 3-5 it fires only partially (precision 0.27, 0.14, 0.23), and the predicate drops these, so they make up most of the remaining 1960 low-magnitude misses (0.4% of mass).

Everything else checks out: 100% of activation mass is in phase 2 on in_tok=q. There are 149 activations in the original phase and none at the delimiter. q at recall_idx >= 4 fires at a constant rate of about 1/30, the same as q's base rate, so it always fires. It never fires at recall_idx <= 1. out_tok, prev_tok and first_tok do not modulate it.
The label 'copy-phase input q from a non-early position' is fair but vague. The firing threshold depends on both how early the q was in the original sequence and how close the step is to the end.
